# Game Idea: Orbital Defender

A minimalist HTML‑canvas game where the player pilots a small ship that orbits a planet. Asteroids drift toward the planet from all sides. The player can rotate around the planet and fire short‑range blasts to destroy incoming asteroids before they hit the surface. The lose condition occurs when any asteroid collides with the planet, ending the game.

1: // Minimal Orbital Defender game
2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> present in the page
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Audio setup
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   // ensure context resumes on first user interaction
10:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
11:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
12:   function playLaser() {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.type = 'square';
16:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     osc.connect(gain);
18:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
20:     osc.start();
21:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.08);
22:   }
23:   function playExplosion() {
24:     const bufferSize = audioCtx.sampleRate * 0.2;
25:     const buffer = audioCtx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, audioCtx.sampleRate);
26:     const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
27:     for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
28:       data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * Math.pow(1 - i / bufferSize, 2);
29:     }
30:     const noise = audioCtx.createBufferSource();
31:     noise.buffer = buffer;
32:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
33:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
34:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
35:     noise.connect(gain);
36:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
37:     noise.start();
38:     noise.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
39:   }
40:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
41:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
42:   // generate simple starfield
43:   const stars = [];
44:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
45:     stars.push({
46:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
47:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
48:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
49:     });
50:   }
51: 
52:   const planet = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2, r: 40 };
53:   const ship = { angle: 0, r: 80, size: 10, cooldown: 0 };
54:   const projectiles = [];
55:   const asteroids = [];
56:   let gameOver = false;
57:   let score = 0;
58: 
59:   // Input handling
60:   const keys = {};
61:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
62:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
63: 
64:   function spawnAsteroid() {
65:     // random angle around planet
66:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
67:     const dist = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height);
68:     const x = planet.x + Math.cos(angle) * dist;
69:     const y = planet.y + Math.sin(angle) * dist;
70:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5;
71:     const vx = (planet.x - x) / dist * speed;
72:     const vy = (planet.y - y) / dist * speed;
73:     const r = 8 + Math.random() * 12;
74:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r });
75:   }
76: 
77:   function update(dt) {
78:     if (gameOver) return;
79:     // Ship rotation
80:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 2 * Math.PI / 180 * dt;
81:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 2 * Math.PI / 180 * dt;
82:     // Fire
83:     if (keys['Space'] && ship.cooldown <= 0) {
84:       const px = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.r;
85:       const py = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.r;
86:       const speed = 4;
87:       projectiles.push({ x: px, y: py, vx: Math.cos(ship.angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(ship.angle) * speed, life: 60 });
88:       playLaser();
89:       ship.cooldown = 20; // frames
90:     }
91:     ship.cooldown = Math.max(0, ship.cooldown - 1);
92: 
93:     // Update projectiles
94:     for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const p = projectiles[i];
96:       p.x += p.vx;
97:       p.y += p.vy;
98:       p.life--;
99:       if (p.life <= 0) projectiles.splice(i, 1);
100:     }
101: 
102:     // Update asteroids
103:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
104:       const a = asteroids[i];
105:       a.x += a.vx;
106:       a.y += a.vy;
107:       // collision with planet
108:       const dx = a.x - planet.x;
109:       const dy = a.y - planet.y;
110:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + planet.r) {
111:         gameOver = true;
112:         break;
113:       }
114:       // collision with projectiles
115:       for (let j = projectiles.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
116:         const p = projectiles[j];
117:         if (Math.hypot(a.x - p.x, a.y - p.y) < a.r + 2) {
118:           score += 10;
119:           playExplosion();
120:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
121:           projectiles.splice(j, 1);
122:           break;
123:         }
124:       }
125:     }
126: 
127:     // Periodically spawn asteroids
128:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
129:   }
130: 
131:   function draw() {
132:     // optional motion blur effect
133:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
134:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
135:     // starfield background
136:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
137:     for (const s of stars) {
138:       ctx.beginPath();
139:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
140:       ctx.fill();
141:     }
142:     // planet with radial gradient (already set in draw)
143:     ctx.beginPath();
144:     ctx.arc(planet.x, planet.y, planet.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
145:     ctx.fill();
146:     // ship as triangle with gradient
147:     const sx = planet.x + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.r;
148:     const sy = planet.y + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.r;
149:     const tipX = sx + Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.size * 1.5;
150:     const tipY = sy + Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.size * 1.5;
151:     const leftX = sx + Math.cos(ship.angle + Math.PI / 2) * ship.size;
152:     const leftY = sy + Math.sin(ship.angle + Math.PI / 2) * ship.size;
153:     const rightX = sx + Math.cos(ship.angle - Math.PI / 2) * ship.size;
154:     const rightY = sy + Math.sin(ship.angle - Math.PI / 2) * ship.size;
155:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(sx, sy, tipX, tipY);
156:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ff00');
157:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003300');
158:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
159:     ctx.beginPath();
160:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY);
161:     ctx.lineTo(leftX, leftY);
162:     ctx.lineTo(rightX, rightY);
163:     ctx.closePath();
164:     ctx.fill();
165:     // projectiles as glowing circles
166:     for (const p of projectiles) {
167:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, 4);
168:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffff88');
169:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8800');
170:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
171:       ctx.beginPath();
172:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
173:       ctx.fill();
174:     }
175:     // asteroids with simple shading
176:     for (const a of asteroids) {
177:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
178:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbbbbb');
179:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555555');
180:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
181:       ctx.beginPath();
182:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
183:       ctx.fill();
184:     }
185:     // UI
186:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
187:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
188:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
189:     if (gameOver) {
190:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
191:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
192:     }
193:     ctx.textAlign = 'start';
194:   }
195:     // asteroids
196:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888888';
197:     for (const a of asteroids) {
198:       ctx.beginPath();
199:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
200:       ctx.fill();
201:     }
202:     // UI
203:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
204:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
205:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
206:     if (gameOver) {
207:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
208:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
209:     }
210:     ctx.textAlign = 'start';
211:   }
212: 
213:   let last = performance.now();
214:   function loop(now) {
215:     const dt = (now - last) / 16.666; // approximate 60fps frames
216:     last = now;
217:     update(dt);
218:     draw();
219:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
220:   }
221:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
222: })();

(End of file - total 222 lines)
</content>
